caption: The drawing features a single human figure in profile, facing to the left, colored in brown for the exposed skin and a solid blue hue for the long tunic or garment that covers most of the body. The figure has black hair and brown feet and hands, and wears a headband with two upright feathers attached. In the left hand, the figure holds a yellow tomahawk-like object, and in the right hand, a brown rifle angled downward. The figure stands on a blue horizontal platform. A vertical pole runs in front of the figure from platform to above head height, intersecting its body slightly to the left of center. The figure and objects are rendered with a marbled or textured effect inside the color fills. The entire composition is enclosed within a plain rectangular border. In the lower right corner, there is a small, simple line drawing of the same figure for scale, placed inside its own small rectangle. The background of the drawing is an off-white or cream color.
title: Indian Chief Weather Vane
